name: cmdb_rel
label: CI Association Type Table
description: The CI association type table is used for configuring management-related queries and reporting scenarios.

fields.name: id
fields.description: ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: from_ci_id
fields.description: Source_model_id. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: from_name
fields.description: Source port name. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: from_label
fields.description: Source port label. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: from_is_cascade_delete
fields.description: Does the source end support cascading deletion?

fields.name: to_ci_id
fields.description: Target end model ID. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: to_group_id
fields.description: Target group by partitioning cmdb_relgroup's ID.

fields.name: to_is_cascade_delete
fields.description: Does the target end support cascading deletion.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the ID field, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_from_ciid
indexes.description: Standard index covering the from_ci_id field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: idx_to_ciid
indexes.description: Standard index covering the to_ci_id field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: uk_from_to_name
indexes.description: Unique index covering the from_name, to_name fields, suitable for exact-match retrieval, uniqueness checks, and duplicate detection.

indexes.name: uk_fromlabel_tolabel
indexes.description: Unique index covering the from_label, to_label fields, suitable for exact-match retrieval, uniqueness checks, and duplicate detection.
